title: Observability / Telemetry pipeline
description: Whether the data behind every other dashboard is complete. Collectors receive, process and export; stores ingest and keep. A failed export here means a gap there.

links.title: Fleet overview
links.tooltip: Start page: every host, service and signal at a glance

list.name: Argo CD syncs
list.expr: (sum by (name, phase) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false",name!~".+-mr-[0-9]+"}[2m])) > 0 unless on (name) sum by (name) (increase(argocd_app_sync_total{dry_run="false"}[1h])) > 6) and on () vector($syncs) > 0

list.name: Host rebuilds
list.expr: (max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds) unless max by (host_name, revision) (sysconf_installed_commit_time_seconds offset 15m)) and on () vector($rebuilds) > 0

list.name: syncs
list.label: Argo CD syncs
list.description: Marks each Argo CD sync on the time series.

list.name: rebuilds
list.label: Host rebuilds
list.description: Marks each NixOS rebuild on the time series.

panels.description: Points per second the collectors failed to deliver. Above zero, panels show gaps or flip between values.
Log records per second the collectors failed to deliver.
Fullest sending queue across all exporters. A full queue drops new data.
Scraped endpoints that missed their last scrape.
Highest share of CPU periods any collector container spent throttled. Above 10 % exports start to time out.

targets.expr: max(sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="observability",container=~"otel-collector.*"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="observability",container=~"otel-collector.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Lowest free disk across the metric, log and trace stores of both stacks.

panels.title: Metric age per host
panels.description: Seconds since the newest metric point from each host. Above two minutes that host stopped reporting.

panels.title: Journal lines per host
panels.description: Journal lines from each host over the last ten minutes. A host missing here stopped shipping logs.

panels.title: Export failures by exporter
panels.description: Points and records per second each exporter failed to deliver.

panels.title: Flow logs per node
panels.description: Hubble's two flow log exporters on each node, the lines that the node collector reads from them, and lines it could not deliver. A node missing here writes no flow log.

panels.title: Flow lines stored per node
panels.description: Gateway and drop lines that VictoriaLogs holds from each node for the last ten minutes. A node at zero while its exporters write lost its collector path.

targets.expr: _time:10m _stream:{service.name="hubble"} | stats by (k8s.node.name) count() if (edge.event:=request) requests, count() if (edge.event:=response) responses, count() if (drop.reason:*) drops

panels.title: Metric points sent
panels.description: Points per second per collector and exporter.

panels.title: Log records sent
panels.description: Records per second per collector and exporter.

panels.title: Queue fill by exporter
panels.description: Sending queue use per exporter. A queue that keeps growing means the target cannot keep up.

panels.title: Collector CPU throttling
panels.description: Share of CPU periods each collector container spent throttled at its limit.

targets.expr: sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace="observability"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace="observability"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Received by receiver
panels.description: Points and records accepted per second per receiver. A receiver dropping to zero lost its source.

panels.title: Scrape targets
panels.description: Every scraped endpoint with its last result and scrape duration.

panels.title: Metric rows ingested
panels.description: Samples per second each VictoriaMetrics store accepted.

panels.title: Log rows ingested
panels.description: Log lines per second each VictoriaLogs store accepted, and lines it dropped.

panels.title: Store disk free
panels.description: Free disk per store. VictoriaLogs also stops at its own size cap.

panels.title: Noisiest log sources
panels.description: Log streams by lines over the selected range. One stream far ahead of the rest drowns the others and fills the store.

targets.expr: * | stats by (_stream) count() lines | sort by (lines desc) | limit 20
